featureDetail.socialDesc: Stay in touch with campus through a Twitter-like social feed. Regular posts, anonymous confessions, polls and more. A full social experience with likes, comments, bookmarks and follow features.
featureDetail.chatDesc: Send private messages to friends, create group chats or join your department's chat room. Stay connected with online status, typing indicators and instant notifications.
featureDetail.foodDesc: Instantly access daily cafeteria and dorm menus. Discover campus restaurants, browse their menus, read reviews and rate them yourself.
featureDetail.transportDesc: Track IYTE shuttle schedules, ESHOT connection times and carpooling listings all in one place. Weekday and weekend schedules can be viewed separately.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about IYTE Mobile

whatIsIyte.a: IYTE Mobile is a comprehensive campus application developed for students of Izmir Institute of Technology (IYTE). It offers features such as food menus, bus schedules, social feed, carpooling, instant messaging and academic documents.

platforms.q: Which platforms is IYTE Mobile available on?
platforms.a: IYTE Mobile is currently available for free on Android devices via Google Play Store. The iOS version will be published on the App Store soon.

foodMenu.q: Can I view the IYTE food menu from the app?
foodMenu.a: Yes, you can view daily cafeteria and KYK dorm menus, discover campus restaurants and leave reviews through IYTE Mobile.

ringService.q: Can I access IYTE ring bus schedules from the app?
ringService.a: Yes, you can view IYTE ring service times, ESHOT connection times, and weekday and weekend schedules separately on IYTE Mobile.

isPaid.a: Yes, IYTE Mobile is completely free. You can download it for free from the Google Play Store.

clubApplication.q: How do I apply as a club?
clubApplication.a: You can apply by filling out the form at iytemobil.com/en/club-application. After your application is reviewed by the team, you will be notified by email. Approved clubs can publish events and interact with students through the app.

documents.q: How do I upload academic documents?
documents.a: Go to iytemobil.com/en/documents, select your department and click 'Upload Document' to upload exam papers, lecture notes and project files in PDF, DOC or DOCX format. Uploaded documents are published after approval.

anonymous.q: Can I post anonymously on the social feed?
anonymous.a: Yes, you can share anonymous confessions on the IYTE Mobile social feed. Posts marked as confessions are published with your identity hidden.

notifications.a: Yes, push notifications are active on IYTE Mobile. New message, like, comment and event notifications are delivered to your phone instantly. You can manage your notification preferences from the profile settings.
